exceptions.reason: The Happy Hours info box has the 1 px light frame the source draws (acm happyhours style-1 `.hp-info`)

The Private Events tile prints #111 text on its accent colour mask exactly as the source does (docs/blocks.md features-intro style-2: only Dark tiles switch to white); the scanner reads the page behind the mask

Advanced Search is Joomla Smart Search's own control (com_finder filters); EmDash search has no equivalent, so no button is drawn and none is faked; the magnifier on the Search button is the same Joomla-only styling; the finder's help paragraphs describe Joomla operators and filters that EmDash search does not take, so they are not drawn (D38)
The results state of the port is its own contract page (en-search-results) with no source page; the source snapshot is the landing state, so its tiles differ by design

Two typos of the demo data are corrected on purpose (Sandwic, Book you table); the wrap of Blackened Fish Sandwich onto two lines at 768 follows from the corrected word; the reader's 'Fruit Platc' is a misreading, the source and the site both print Fruit Plate

fonts.platform: Chromium (Playwright). Two families are shipped locally (src/fonts.json): Playfair Display (display) and Roboto (body).
